hero.title: Provide Professional Services and Grow With the EPEW Ecosystem
hero.description: EPEW works with qualified vendors, professionals, contractors, suppliers, and service providers who can support the development and operation of entrepreneur-owned businesses.

about.title: Who Can Become an EPEW Vendor?
about.paragraph1: An EPEW Vendor may be a business, independent professional, contractor, supplier, consultant, technician, or specialized service provider capable of delivering reliable products or professional services.
about.paragraph2: Vendor participation is subject to application review, qualification, compliance verification, and approval before access to EPEW Vendor opportunities is granted.

business.title: Business & Professional Services
business.text: Business registration, accounting, tax preparation, consulting, legal services, insurance, and other professional support.

technology.title: Technology & Digital Services
technology.text: Website development, software, IT services, digital systems, technical support, and technology solutions.

marketing.title: Marketing, Branding & Promotion
marketing.text: Graphic design, printing, signage, advertising, social media, media production, promotion, and business visibility services.

construction.title: Construction & Property Services
construction.text: Construction, renovation, repair, installation, maintenance, commercial space preparation, and related property services.

equipment.title: Equipment, Inventory & Supplies
equipment.text: Business equipment, machinery, furniture, inventory, supplies, materials, and other approved business resources.

specialized.title: Specialized Vendor Services
specialized.text: Transportation, delivery, training, beauty, food service, event support, technical trades, and other specialized business services.

qualification.title: Vendor Qualification & Compliance
qualification.description: EPEW may verify Vendor qualifications before approval and during active participation in the Vendor network.

items.credentials: Required licenses, certifications, or professional credentials
items.insurance: Insurance or other compliance documentation when required
items.capacity: Ability to complete assigned work professionally and reliably
items.standards: Agreement to follow EPEW Vendor standards and contractual requirements

benefits.title: Why Join the EPEW Vendor Network?
benefits.description: Qualified Vendors become part of a growing enterprise ecosystem designed to create recurring opportunities as new entrepreneurs develop and operate their businesses.

opportunities.title: Business Opportunities
opportunities.text: Gain access to potential service and supply opportunities generated throughout the EPEW ecosystem.

matching.title: Expertise-Based Matching
matching.text: Vendor qualifications and service expertise may be used to identify appropriate opportunities.

growth.title: Network Growth
growth.text: Build professional relationships and expand visibility within a growing entrepreneurship network.

performance.title: Performance Recognition
performance.text: Strong service quality and reliable performance can strengthen a Vendor's standing within the network.

cta.title: Become an EPEW Vendor
cta.description: Submit your Vendor application for review. Approved Vendors may receive access to opportunities that match their qualifications, services, and operating capacity.
